terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: The terms under which Zirtuno offers this website and the enquiries made through it.

sections.heading: What this site is
sections.body: zirtuno.com presents Zirtuno's work, services and method. It is an informational site: nothing on it constitutes a binding offer, a quote, or a commitment to deliver. Scope, price and schedule for any engagement are agreed in a separate written contract.

sections.heading: Enquiries
sections.body: The contact form sends your message to a Zirtuno inbox so we can reply. Sending it starts a conversation and nothing more: it creates no client relationship and no obligation on either side until a signed agreement exists.

sections.heading: Portfolio and concept work
sections.body: Some pieces shown here are concepts or architectures rather than delivered client projects, and are labelled as such where they appear. Client names and results are published only with that client's permission.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: The Zirtuno name, mark, written copy, visual design and the code behind this site belong to Zirtuno. Client marks and work shown in the portfolio remain the property of their owners. You may link to and quote from this site with attribution; you may not reproduce it wholesale or present it as your own.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: We keep the site working but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Features that depend on your device, in particular the animated field, which requires WebGL, degrade to a static alternative rather than failing, and the full content of every page stays readable without them.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Brazil, with the courts of Curitiba, Paraná as the venue for any dispute.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: What this site collects, why, and how little of it there is.

sections.heading: The short version
sections.body: This site has no accounts, no logins and no advertising. The only personal data it receives is what you type into the contact form. Everything else we measure is anonymous and aggregated.

sections.heading: What the contact form collects
sections.body: The name, email address and message you submit, plus which call to action you arrived from, so we can answer in context. It is delivered to a Zirtuno inbox by Resend, our email provider, and is used to reply to you and to keep a record of the conversation. It is never sold, and never used for marketing you did not ask for.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: We use Plausible Analytics, which is cookieless and does not build a profile of you or follow you across sites. It reports page views, referrers and coarse country-level location in aggregate. We also record anonymous page-performance measurements (Core Web Vitals) to find slow pages. None of this identifies you.

sections.heading: Storage on your device
sections.body: The site stores two small values in your browser's session storage: the chapter you were reading, so switching language returns you to the same place, and a one-time measurement of your device's graphics performance, so the animated field does not have to re-test itself on every page. Both are cleared when you close the tab and neither leaves your device.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under the LGPD you may ask what personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, and ask us to delete it. Write to us through the contact form and we will act on the request.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Contact-form messages are kept while the enquiry is live and for as long afterwards as we need them for our records. Ask us to delete yours and we will.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.summary: This site sets no cookies. Here is what it does instead.

sections.heading: No cookies
sections.body: Zirtuno sets no cookies on this site: not for analytics, not for advertising, not for preferences. That is why you were never shown a consent banner. There is nothing to consent to.

sections.heading: Why analytics needs none
sections.body: Plausible Analytics, the tool we use, was built to measure traffic without cookies and without identifying visitors. It counts visits; it does not follow people.

sections.heading: Language
sections.body: Your language is carried in the address itself, /pt/ or /en/, rather than remembered in a cookie. Bookmark a page and it stays in the language you chose.

sections.heading: Session storage
sections.body: Two values live in your browser's session storage rather than in cookies: your place in the page across a language switch, and a one-time graphics-performance measurement. They are not cookies, are never sent to a server, and disappear when you close the tab.

sections.heading: If this changes
sections.body: Should we ever introduce a cookie, this page will say so before it is set, and you will be asked first.

careers.metaDescription: Zirtuno is a small, multidisciplinary studio in Curitiba. We keep no public list of openings. We read what arrives.
careers.title: Work with us
careers.lead: We are a small, multidisciplinary team, organised by function rather than by title. If you build things that have to hold up after the launch, we would like to know you exist.
careers.functionsBody: Six functions, each owning a real part of the work. Most people here are strong in one and useful in a second. That overlap is what lets a small team carry a whole ecosystem.

traits.heading: Range over specialism
traits.body: A complete ecosystem is one argument told across strategy, design, engineering and growth. We would rather work with someone who can follow that argument end to end than with a specialist who hands it off at the border.

traits.heading: Finished, not just shipped
traits.body: The details that survive contact with a real user are the ones nobody was asked to fix. If you notice the descender that gets clipped and the state nobody designed, you will recognise how this studio works.

traits.heading: Discretion
traits.body: Much of the work is done in someone else's name. The mantra on the homepage is not decoration: we are about being felt, remembered and carried forward, not about appearing.

careers.applyBody: There is no vacancy list here, and no form with a dropdown of roles that do not exist yet. Write to us. Tell us which function you would own, what you have built, and where we can see it: a repository, a portfolio, a product that is live.
careers.applyNote: Your message reaches the same inbox as every other enquiry, tagged so it is not filed as a commercial lead.
